title: UI: Actions pane consistency, resizable panes, bottom tab group with collapse
description: Several related layout improvements: (1) Actions window/pane should look and behave like other panels (consistent header, background, padding, font); (2) All panes should be resizable via drag handles between them; (3) Bottom area should group Actions, Timeline, Sound, Properties as tabs that are collapsible — clicking the active tab collapses/expands the bottom panel. This is a significant layout refactor of Shell.tsx. Start by auditing the current layout: where are the panels rendered, what controls their sizing, and what the current tab behavior looks like.
